questions.explanation:
Let us assume potential at point M is X volts. Now you can see a plain wire is directly connected between point N and point M so point N will also have same potential as point M.

Similarly, a plain wire is directly connected between point N and point O so point O will also have same potential as point N.

Also, a plain wire is directly connected between point O and point P so point P will also have same potential as point O.

Now you can see point P and point M both have same potential X, so no current will flow through that path so you can remove that resistor. Similarly, as point O and point M both have same potential X, so no current will flow through that path also so you can remove that resistor too.

So new circuit becomes
RAB = R + R = 2R

questions.content:
The correct match between items of List-I and List-II is :

List - I List - II
(A) Coloured impurity (P) Steam distilation
(B) Mixture of o-nitrophenol
and p-nitrophenol		 (Q) Fractional distilation
(C) Crude Naphtha (R) Charcoal treatment
(d) Mixture of glycerol
and sugars		 (S) Distillation under
reduced pressure
questions.explanation:
(a) Charcoal treatment removes coloured impurity through adsorption.

(b) Steam distillation separates the mixture of o-nitrophenol and p-nitrophenol. The o-nitrophenol is steam volatile (due to intramolecular hydrogen bonding), and the para isomer is not volatile.

(c) Fractional distillation separates crude naphtha. Naphtha is a flammable liquid hydrocarbon mixture.

(d) Distillation under reduced pressure separates mixture of glycerol and sugars. Vacuum distillation lowers the boiling point and prevents decomposition.

questions.content: The increasing order of nitration of the following compounds is :

options.content: (b) < (a) < (c) < (d)
(a) < (b) < (c) < (d)
(b) < (a) < (d) < (c)
(a) < (b) < (d) < (c)

questions.explanation:
Nitration is an electrophilic substitution reaction. So, the group which increase the electron density on benzene ring will increase the electrophilic substitution reaction.

Here OCH3 group shows + R effect, but CH3 group shows + I effect. As + R effect is more effective than + I effect so OCH3 will increase more electron density on benzene ring.

Cl has strong electron withdrawing effect ( I). So it decrease electron density on the benzene ring.

In acidic medium, aniline form anilinium ion.


This anilinium ion is least reactive as in benzene ring electron density is least.

   The increasing order is (a) < (b) < (d) < (c)
